name: 66538 · Seneca, KS
findings: ZIP 66538 (Seneca) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66538 (Seneca) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66538 (Seneca) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
